assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The symptoms are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
CPT 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring) is supported.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The diagnosis of atrial fibrillation, unspecified (I49.9) further confirms the need to capture intermittent arrhythmias not detectable on ambulatory monitoring.
